newsitem.title: FRANCE: RUGBY UNION-FRANCE PICK MAKESHIFT SIDE AGAINST ITALY.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-FRANCE PICK MAKESHIFT SIDE AGAINST ITALY.

text.p: Former captain Philippe Saint-Andre returns for newly-crowned Five Nations champions France in a much-changed team to play Italy in Saturday's test in Grenoble.

Wing Saint-Andre, out for more than three months after a groin surgery, was named on Thursday in a completely changed three-quarter line after missing the two tests against South Africa last year and the Five Nations tournament.
"Three and a half months ago, I didn't know if I'd play rugby again," Saint-Andre said. "I'm reviving. I want to take and give pleasure and win with the French team."
Half the side who clinched the grand slam last weekend are missing because of World Sevens or club commitments or they are being rested before the tour to Australia in June.
Captain Abdelatif Benazzi, who is nursing bruised ribs, is among them. Fellow back row forward Fabien Pelous is captain for the day.

Narbonne centre Pierre Bondouy wins his first cap, World Cup flanker Philippe Benetton also returns after injury kept him out of the Five Nations tournament and hooker Marc de Rougemont will try a new position for him at prop.
"The match will be a reference for the tour of Australia," coach Jean-Claude Skrela said. "Some players must show they have the required capacity to get on the plane."

Team: 15-Jean-Luc Sadourny; 14-Stephane Ougier, 13-Yann Delaigue, 12-Pierre Bondouy, 11-Philippe Saint-Andre; 10-David Aucagne, 9-Guy Accoceberry; 8-Fabien Pelous (captain), 7-Philippe Benetton, 6-Arnaud Costes, 5-Hugues Miorin, 4-Olivier Merle, 3-Franck Tournaire, 2-Marc Dal Maso, 1-Marc de Rougemont.
